statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let N := fun (X : ℕ) => 2*X+5; let f := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ∈ w X ∧ n.Prime then Real.log n else 0; let energy := fun (X : ℕ) => letI : NeZero (N X) := ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero _⟩; ∑ k : ZMod (N X), (ZMod.stdAddChar (N:=N X) (2*k)).re * ‖ZMod.dft (fun j : ZMod (N X) => ((f X j.val:ℝ):ℂ)) k‖^2; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B<X ∧ 0<energy X

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定平移的 Θ 提升 · TP-0052R · 在无界尺度估计指定差二测试的谱能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta lift for a prescribed shift · TP-0052R · Bound the signed energy of the prescribed gap-two test on unbounded scales

brief.zh: TP-0052 的修正版，与 TP-0054 等价。挑战要求对实际素数权证明无界尺度上的正性。任意固定尺度的有限检验仅校验归一化。
brief.en: This replaces TP-0052 and is equivalent to TP-0054. The challenge asks for positive energy of the actual prime weights at unbounded scales. A finite check at a fixed scale only tests the normalization.
